name: Max Burns
bio: A Representative from Georgia; born in Millen, Jenkins County, Ga., on November 8, 1948; graduated from Screven County High School, Ga., 1967; B.A., Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, Ga., 1973; M.B.A, Georgia State University, Atlanta, Ga., 1977; Ph.D., Georgia State University, Atlanta, Ga., 1987; United States Army Reserve, 1973-1981; Screven County, Ga., Commission, 1993-1998; elected as a Republican to the One Hundred Eighth Congress (January 3, 2003-January 3, 2005); unsuccessful candidate for reelection in 2004.
